description: Class representing a table of contents.

Delete.description: Removes the table of contents from the document.
Delete.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetClassType.description: Returns a type of the ApiTableOfContents class.
GetClassType.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetIncludePageNumbers.description: Returns whether page numbers are shown in the table of contents.
GetIncludePageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetLowerHeadingLevel.description: Returns the lowest (innermost) heading level included in the table of contents.
GetLowerHeadingLevel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetParent.description: Returns the document that contains the table of contents.
GetParent.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetRange.description: Returns a range that covers the entire table of contents.
GetRange.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetRightAlignPageNumbers.description: Returns whether page numbers are right-aligned in the table of contents.
GetRightAlignPageNumbers.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetUpperHeadingLevel.description: Returns the highest (outermost) heading level included in the table of contents.
GetUpperHeadingLevel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

GetUseHyperlinks.description: Returns whether entries are formatted as hyperlinks.
GetUseHyperlinks.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.

SetLowerHeadingLevel.description: Sets the lowest (innermost) heading level included in the table of contents.
SetLowerHeadingLevel.requires: ONLYOFFICE Docs Developer Edition. This member is not present in Community Edition builds.
